name: webmcp-kit
description: Add WebMCP tools to a web app: map user journeys in a visual Explorer, implement approved tools through the app's own logic, and verify them in a real browser.

interface.longDescription: Map a web app's user journeys in a visual Explorer, propose WebMCP tools for approval, implement them through the app's own logic, and verify each tool in a real browser.
defaultPrompt: Make this web app agent-ready with WebMCP tools.
Verify this site's WebMCP tools in a browser.
Connect this site's existing WebMCP tools without rebuilding them.
